question: Analyze the trend of Healthy Life Expectancy At Birth by region (Asia, Europe, North America)
query: SELECT regional_indicator, AVG(healthy_life_expectancy_at_birth) AS avg_healthy_life_expectancy FROM world_happiness_report WHERE regional_indicator IN ('Asia') GROUP BY regional_indicator LIMIT 50;
